title: Activation patching with indirect object identification

cues.en: There are two concepts that you are going to learn in this video activation patching and the indirect
cues.zh: 這支影片要學兩個概念：活化修補，以及間接

cues.en: object identification task, which is often abbreviated to I, o.
cues.zh: 受詞辨識任務，常縮寫為 IO。

cues.en: And actually activation.
cues.zh: 其實，活化

cues.en: Patching is just another term for editing the internal activations.
cues.zh: 修補，只是編輯內部活化的另一個說法。

cues.en: So there's really only one concept to learn in this video.
cues.zh: 所以，這支影片真正要學的概念，其實只有一個。

cues.en: The I o test is often used to study language models, and it basically just assesses the model's ability
cues.zh: IO 測試經常用來研究語言模型，基本上是在評估模型

cues.en: to understand grammar and in particular, indirect objects.
cues.zh: 理解文法，尤其是間接受詞的能力。

cues.en: Let me start by telling you about activation patching.
cues.zh: 先介紹活化修補。

cues.en: So imagine you have some language model that is processing a text sequence.
cues.zh: 想像某個語言模型正在處理文字序列。

cues.en: And that's what I'm depicting here.
cues.zh: 這裡就是示意圖。

cues.en: So we have text sequence A and I'm using this one letter to refer to a whole sequence of tokens, like a whole sentence.
cues.zh: 有文字序列 A，我用這個字母，代表一整個 token 序列，例如完整句子。

cues.en: And here I'm just depicting the embeddings vectors traversing from one transformer block to the next and being slightly modified at each step.
cues.zh: 圖中畫的是嵌入向量，從一個 Transformer 區塊走到下一個，每一步都稍微改變。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: All fine.
cues.zh: 都沒問題。

cues.en: Now imagine we have exactly the same model, but processing a slightly different token sequence.
cues.zh: 現在，想像完全相同的模型，正在處理稍微不同的 token 序列。

cues.en: Maybe A and B are the same sentence, but they differ by one word.
cues.zh: 也許 A 和 B 是相同句子，但差一個詞。

cues.en: So that means that the embeddings vectors from this sequence will be at least a little bit different.
cues.zh: 這代表，這個序列的嵌入向量，至少會有一點不同。

cues.en: Okay, so now the idea of activation patching is to transplant the activations from this sequence onto
cues.zh: 好，活化修補的概念，就是把這個序列的活化，移植到

cues.en: this sequence.
cues.zh: 這個序列。

cues.en: So we take the actual activations from one block, let's say transformer block T plus one.
cues.zh: 取出某個區塊的實際活化，例如 Transformer 區塊 T+1。

cues.en: And we literally just copy those activation vectors and paste them onto the output of transformer block T plus one over here.
cues.zh: 真的只要複製那些活化向量，貼到這裡的 Transformer 區塊 T+1 輸出上。

cues.en: In practice, this is generally done only for one key token that carries a lot of information.
cues.zh: 實務上，一般只針對一個包含大量資訊的關鍵 token。

cues.en: So now going forwards we have what is sometimes called the corrupted information for this model by patching
cues.zh: 因此，接下來，這個模型就有了有時稱為受損的資訊，因為修補進了

cues.en: in the activations from a different model or well it's the same model but processing a different token sequence.
cues.zh: 另一個模型，或者其實是相同模型、但處理不同 token 序列的活化。

cues.en: So on the one hand this is literally just editing the activations, just like lots of other examples and techniques that you are learning about in this section.
cues.zh: 一方面，這真的只是編輯活化，就像這個章節中學到的很多其他範例與技術。

cues.en: But the reason why they call this patching is because you are taking like a patch of activations from
cues.zh: 但之所以稱為修補，是因為取出一段 token 序列的

cues.en: one token sequence and transplanting it into another.
cues.zh: 一塊活化，移植到另一個序列。

cues.en: You could also think of this as like the donor model and the recipient model.
cues.zh: 也可以把它想成供體模型與受體模型。

cues.en: Here is another diagram that illustrates this concept.
cues.zh: 這裡有另一張圖，說明這個概念。

cues.en: So there's a lot of stuff going on in this whole figure.
cues.zh: 整張圖內容很多。

cues.en: That's fine.
cues.zh: 沒關係。

cues.en: I just want to draw your attention up to here to this depiction here.
cues.zh: 只想請你注意上面這裡的示意圖。

cues.en: So the idea is that you take the activations from processing one token from one model, and you implant
cues.zh: 概念是，從某個模型取出處理某個 token 的活化，再植入

cues.en: it into the same position when the model is processing a slightly different sequence of tokens.
cues.zh: 模型處理稍微不同 token 序列時的相同位置。

cues.en: And it turns out that depending on exactly where you perform this patching, you might observe no impact or a really significant impact on the final output.
cues.zh: 結果，取決於修補的確切位置，可能對最終輸出

cues.en: Logits of the model.
cues.zh: logit 完全沒有影響，也可能有非常大的影響。

cues.en: Okay, so you are going to see exactly how this works in in code in a few minutes.
cues.zh: 好，幾分鐘後，會在程式碼中看到它如何運作。

cues.en: But first let me switch to explaining the IOI task.
cues.zh: 但先介紹 IOI 任務。

cues.en: So an indirect object refers to a noun that receives the direct object from the subject.
cues.zh: 間接受詞，是指從主詞接收直接受詞的名詞。

cues.en: If you're not so familiar with English grammar, or maybe it's been several years since you studied all these grammar terms, then that definition might sound really abstract.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉英文文法，或已經很多年沒學這些文法術語，這個定義可能聽起來很抽象。

cues.en: Here's an example.
cues.zh: 這裡有個例子。

cues.en: Bob and Barbara went to the beach.
cues.zh: Bob 和 Barbara 去海邊。

cues.en: Bob gave the umbrella to her.
cues.zh: Bob 把傘給了她。

cues.en: So in this sentence, Bob is the subject, the umbrella is the direct object, and Barbara is the indirect
cues.zh: 這個句子中，Bob 是主詞，傘是直接受詞，Barbara 是間接

cues.en: object.
cues.zh: 受詞。

cues.en: And you know from context that the pronoun her here refers to Barbara.
cues.zh: 根據上下文，你知道 her 這個代名詞指的是 Barbara。

cues.en: In fact, if I would even drop the word her altogether and just stop the sentence with two, you would still be able to predict what the most likely next word was.
cues.zh: 其實，就算完全拿掉 her，讓句子停在 to，你仍能預測最可能的下一個詞。

cues.en: It would be either Barbara or her, and the fact that you can identify the indirect object from the
cues.zh: 會是 Barbara 或 her。而你能根據

cues.en: context of these two sentences is exactly the indirect object identification task.
cues.zh: 這兩個句子的上下文，辨識間接受詞，正是間接受詞辨識任務。

cues.en: And when we run this test through the model, then the idea is that we grab the final output logits
cues.zh: 模型執行這個測試時，概念是取得最終輸出 logit，

cues.en: and literally just subtract the logits for Barbara versus Bob or her versus him.
cues.zh: 直接將 Barbara 與 Bob，或 her 與 him 的 logit 相減。

cues.en: There's a couple of different ways you can set it up, but that's the basic idea.
cues.zh: 有幾種設定方式，但基本概念就是如此。

cues.en: So, uh, in an experiment, we craft a sentence such that the indirect object is the final word, like in this example here.
cues.zh: 實驗中，會設計句子，讓間接受詞是最後一個詞，就像這裡的例子。

cues.en: Then we drop the indirect object, run a forward pass, and then we calculate this delta value here for the two possibilities of indirect objects.
cues.zh: 接著，移除間接受詞，做前向傳播，對兩個可能的間接受詞，計算這個 delta 值。

cues.en: So for example her minus him or maybe Bob minus Barbara.
cues.zh: 例如，her 減 him，或 Bob 減 Barbara。

cues.en: So this is the basic version of the task.
cues.zh: 這是任務的基本版本。

cues.en: And what I will show you in the code demo is how to measure changes in this task performance metric when we patch different parts of the model.
cues.zh: 程式示範會展示，修補模型不同部分時，如何衡量這個任務表現指標的變化。

cues.en: So the purpose of this video is to introduce you to setting up the experiment and how patching works.
cues.zh: 所以，這支影片的目的，是介紹如何設定實驗，以及修補如何運作。

cues.en: And then we will return to this experiment in the next section of the course when we start manipulating individual attention heads.
cues.zh: 課程下一個章節開始操作個別注意力頭時，還會回到這個實驗。

cues.en: I'm going to work with GPT two XL here.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 GPT2 XL。

cues.en: And I'll put it on the GPU because the text sequence is short, but we do process it once per transformer block, which means we need to do 48 forward passes.
cues.zh: 放在 GPU，因為文字序列雖短，但每個 Transformer 區塊都會處理一次，也就是需要 48 次前向傳播。

cues.en: So here is the token sequence.
cues.zh: 這裡是 token 序列。

cues.en: Here's the text that we will use.
cues.zh: 這是要使用的文字。

cues.en: So in an I o test you always have a pair of sentences that you have the subject and indirect objects swapped.
cues.zh: IO 測試中，總會有一對句子，將主詞與間接受詞交換。

cues.en: And why do we want them swapped.
cues.zh: 為什麼要交換？

cues.en: Well the idea is that we grab the internal activations Deviations from this token here for Mike, and
cues.zh: 概念是，取得這裡 Mike 這個 token 的內部活化，

cues.en: then patch that onto this sentence in the same token index position in place of Emma.
cues.zh: 再修補到這個句子相同 token 索引位置，取代 Emma。

cues.en: And the thing is that in this second sentence, the correct token after two would really be Mike.
cues.zh: 第二個句子中，to 後面的正確 token，實際應該是 Mike。

cues.en: However, if we take the activations for this word Mike over here and patch that onto the second sentence,
cues.zh: 但如果從這裡取出 Mike 這個詞的活化，修補到第二個句子，

cues.en: and then maybe the model will start preferring the token for Emma at the end of this sequence.
cues.zh: 模型也許就會開始偏好在序列最後輸出 Emma token。

cues.en: So that's the idea of this manipulation.
cues.zh: 這就是這個操作的概念。

cues.en: Before getting there, we can calculate the IOI on clean versions of the model, which means no patching, no manipulations.
cues.zh: 在此之前，可以對乾淨的模型版本計算 IOI，也就是沒有修補、沒有操作。

cues.en: Here you can see I'm calculating the logit differences of the final tokens for these two target words.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，我計算最後 token 對這兩個目標詞的 logit 差。

cues.en: Now in the first sentence the correct token is the word Emma.
cues.zh: 第一個句子，正確 token 是 Emma。

cues.en: So the token logit for Emma should have a higher logit value than Mike.
cues.zh: 所以，Emma 的 token logit 應該比 Mike 高。

cues.en: And you see that indeed, the IOI value there is -3.3.
cues.zh: 確實可以看到，那裡的 IOI 值是 -3.3。

cues.en: And then when we swap the order, the model should prefer Mike over Emma.
cues.zh: 交換順序之後，模型應該偏好 Mike，而非 Emma。

cues.en: And there we see a positive IOI value of 2.1.
cues.zh: 這裡看到正的 IOI 值 2.1。

cues.en: So these values are our clean estimates of the model's understanding of grammar and indirect objects.
cues.zh: 這些值，就是對模型文法與間接受詞理解能力的乾淨估計。

cues.en: Now we are ready for the experiment.
cues.zh: 現在，準備做實驗。

cues.en: Here you see a for loop over all of the layers in the model.
cues.zh: 這裡是遍歷模型所有層的 for 迴圈。

cues.en: Now so far in this section of the course I have separated defining and implanting the hook function from the rest of the code to test the manipulation.
cues.zh: 這個章節到目前為止，我都將 hook 的定義、植入，與測試操作的其他程式碼分開。

cues.en: But now here I'm setting it up slightly differently.
cues.zh: 但這裡設定稍微不同。

cues.en: So here I'm creating the hook function, implanting it, and then removing it all at each iteration within this for loop.
cues.zh: 每次 for 迴圈內，都建立 hook 函數、植入，再移除。

cues.en: So these hook functions only go into the model exactly when we need them, and then they are immediately obliterated after we no longer need them.
cues.zh: 所以，只有真的需要時，才把 hook 放進模型；不需要後，立刻消除。

cues.en: And what is happening inside this for loop.
cues.zh: 這個 for 迴圈裡，發生什麼？

cues.en: Well here you can see I'm running a forward pass.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，我做一次前向傳播。

cues.en: This is a forward pass for the M tokens, which means Emma gave the coffee to Mike.
cues.zh: 這是 EM token 的前向傳播，也就是 Emma 把咖啡給 Mike。

cues.en: So the correct token to predict here at the end of this sequence is Mike.
cues.zh: 所以，序列最後，正確預測 token 是 Mike。

cues.en: And then I'm grabbing the hidden states here.
cues.zh: 接著，這裡取得隱藏狀態。

cues.en: So the outputs of the transformer blocks.
cues.zh: 也就是 Transformer 區塊輸出。

cues.en: Now this code is exactly the same for every layer of the model.
cues.zh: 這段程式碼，對模型每一層都完全相同。

cues.en: And what differs for each layer is the hook function up here.
cues.zh: 每層不同的，是上面的 hook 函數。

cues.en: So here you can see I'm implanting the hook into the entire transformer block, so that when I grab the hidden states up here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，hook 植入整個 Transformer 區塊，所以，在上面取得隱藏狀態時，

cues.en: That is the output of the transformer block.
cues.zh: 那就是 Transformer 區塊的輸出。

cues.en: And that's exactly the same as the hidden states that I am grabbing in the forward pass down here on this line.
cues.zh: 與下面這一行前向傳播取得的隱藏狀態，完全相同。

cues.en: And also what I got earlier from the clean run.
cues.zh: 也與先前乾淨執行取得的相同。

cues.en: And then here on this line of code, I am replacing the final token and all of the embeddings vectors with the hidden states from layer I plus one.
cues.zh: 接著，在這行程式碼，把最後一個 token 的全部嵌入向量，替換成第 i+1 層的隱藏狀態。

cues.en: And then also the final token and all the embeddings vectors.
cues.zh: 同樣，取最後一個 token，以及全部嵌入向量。

cues.en: Now these hidden states were taken from the me text, which means Mike gave the coffee to Emma.
cues.zh: 這些隱藏狀態，來自 ME 文字，也就是 Mike 把咖啡給 Emma。

cues.en: So Emma is the correct output in this token sequence.
cues.zh: 所以，這個 token 序列的正確輸出是 Emma。

cues.en: So that is the line that does the patching.
cues.zh: 這就是執行修補的那一行。

cues.en: I'm taking the activations from the donor model and transplanting them onto the activations in the recipient model.
cues.zh: 從供體模型取出活化，移植到受體模型的活化上。

cues.en: Now here's a question for you.
cues.zh: 這裡有個問題。

cues.en: Why am I looping over layer I up here but I write I plus one over here for this index.
cues.zh: 為什麼上面遍歷第 i 層，這裡的索引卻寫 i+1？

cues.en: Something for you to think about.
cues.zh: 留給你思考。

cues.en: And when I discuss and when I switch to code, I will explain why that plus one is there anyway.
cues.zh: 切換到程式碼討論時，會解釋為何有加一。

cues.en: So that's the main part of this for loop.
cues.zh: 這就是 for 迴圈的主要部分。

cues.en: There's a couple of additional lines down here that I didn't put into the screenshot, but that just calculates the IOI metric as I showed a moment ago.
cues.zh: 下面還有幾行沒放進截圖，只是像剛才展示的，計算 IOI 指標。

cues.en: So this means that we will have an IOI measure for each of the layers that we patch.

cues.zh: y 軸是 logit 差，也就是 Mike token

cues.zh: 與 Emma token 輸出 logit 的差。我設定減法方向，讓 Mike 對應正數，Emma 對應負數。

cues.zh: 也就是沒有操作。
